about: The trailers' edit (editTrailer.mjs; check one with: node tools/crazygames/editTrailer.mjs --storyboard land). intro: the cover's hold, its dissolve into the first shot, and its push-in. Each shot: s = scene (recordTrailer.mjs), at = a mark in it ('reveal', 'steps.2': the third luck tokens popping out of the reels; marks.json), t = seconds from that mark (or from the scene's start), d = length. land / port = that format's camera, in stage px (land: the PC stage, 2160 x 960, battle at x 0-1080, menus at x 1080-2160; port: the phone stage, 1080 x 1920, battle at y 0-960, menus below): c = centre, c2 = centre at the end, w = [start, end] width seen (the height follows the format), ease = out (default), inout, in or linear. box = keep the view inside [x0, y0, x1, y1], or "battle" (the battle view alone). A camera may override t, d or at for its format. punch = quick zooms on impacts: at (s into the shot), amt (0.12 = 12% closer), c (toward), release, hold. shake = impact shakes: at, amp (output px), dur. flash = white: at, amt, dur. Landmarks (the battle is the same in both stages): raccoon ~347,773; foes x 850-1010 at y 740-830; damage numbers y 450-700; world banner y 127-247, x 160-920; boss bar y 200-285; luck rows (a row per reel): x 300-1015, y 150-500, 'MATCH! LUCK SQUARED' y 540, x 210-855, showing 1.13 s after its step's tokens pop out; reel 1: land 1296,274 / port 217,1233. Reveal, counting up: land card 1080,492, '1 in' bar y 720; port card 540,972, bar y 1200. Reveal, landed: land card 1080,384, title y 147, bar y 615, name y 716; port card 540,858, title y 625, bar y 1092, name y 1197.
